# ui-skills by ibelick — vendor hub

This vendor has no single master skill; it ships 3 tools, each a command of its own.
`/design-tools:ibelick <tool> <target>` runs that tool; `/design-tools:ibelick` alone lists them.

**Request:** $ARGUMENTS

## Do

- If the request starts with one of the tool names below, run it exactly as its own command would
  (`commands/<command>.md`): resolve with `bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/resolve.sh" <tool>`,
  load (`load: skill` → Skill tool; `load: read` → Read and follow, base first), brand contract before
  any write, run, report what changed. Read-only tools change nothing.
- If it names none of them, print the list below with one line each and ask which one — do not guess,
  and do not run two.

## Tools

- `/design-tools:ibelick-baseline-ui` — Base tidiness checklist: spacing, alignment, contrast, consistency; read-only. (read-only)
- `/design-tools:ibelick-fixing-accessibility` — Fast targeted accessibility fixes: focus ring, tab order, labels, ARIA. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ibelick-fixing-motion-performance` — Fixes janky animation: compositor-only properties, layout thrash, reduced-motion, perf budget. (writes)
